art_direction: 成年罗宾穿淡紫无袖上衣与奶油色亚麻短裤，沿海边书屋露台轻快迈步，一手合书、一手扶住被海风吹动的宽檐帽。
composition_variation: Create an original premium anime portrait wallpaper of Nico Robin, unmistakably her adult age of thirty, with long black hair, blue eyes, and a composed, knowing smile. On a Mediterranean seaside library terrace, she takes a confident forward step while closing a small paperback with one hand and steadying a straw hat with the other. Dress her in an opaque lavender sleeveless boatneck blouse, loose cream linen shorts, and flat woven sandals. Her movement feels breezy and self-assured, never sexual. Wind lifts loose hair and the blouse hem naturally. Use turquoise sea, pale limestone, a tiny bougainvillea accent, crisp elegant linework, and luminous summer shadows. Leave the top quarter as uncluttered pale sky. Center her face around forty-five percent of the image height; keep her face and both hands inside the narrow central safe region.
